title: Group announcements
lead: A short message for your group’s members. Once published, each member gets it in their space. No e-mail or SMS.
no_group_p: You have no group to lead yet. Ask the secretariat.
empty_p: Write a first one: a moved meeting, a reminder, good news.
f_link_hint: A page of the site (/en/agenda/) or an https address.
f_expires_hint: With no date, the announcement stays until you take it down.
ph_body: La répétition de ce jeudi a lieu samedi à la même heure.
ph_body_en: This Thursday’s rehearsal is on Saturday, same time.
error: That could not be done. Try again.
publish_p: Each member of the group will get a notification in their space.
expire_p: It stops showing and its notifications are closed.
delete_p: It is gone for good, with its notifications.
